description: This file defines the ParserTransitionsWm class, a specialized parser for window manager transition trace data, including methods for decoding trace buffers, extracting timestamps, and parsing transition entries.

classes.name: ParserTransitionsWm
classes.description: A parser class for window manager transition trace data, extending AbstractParser, with methods for decoding, timestamp extraction, and transition entry parsing.

methods.name: getTraceType
methods.description: Returns the trace type associated with this parser, specifically WM_TRANSITION.

methods.name: processDecodedEntry
methods.description: Processes a decoded trace entry, returning a parsed Transition object.

methods.name: decodeTrace
methods.description: Decodes a trace buffer into transition entries, handling the real-to-elapsed time offset.

methods.name: getMagicNumber
methods.description: Returns the magic number sequence identifying the trace file format.

methods.name: getTimestamp
methods.description: Extracts a timestamp from a transition entry based on the specified timestamp type.

methods.name: parseWmTransitionEntry
methods.description: Parses a raw transition entry into a Transition object, validating and converting timestamps and IDs.

methods.name: validateWmTransitionEntry
methods.description: Validates that a transition entry has a non-zero ID and at least one timestamp.
